title: LeetLens solving session
description: One attempt at one LeetCode problem, recorded by the LeetLens extension and committed to the user's data repo as data/sessions/<dir_key>/<started_at>_<session_id>.json. This schema is the contract between the extension, the indexer, the dashboard, and the MCP server; additionalProperties is false throughout, so adding a field is a breaking change (new LEETLENS_REF major tag).

session_id.description: Random 8-char id, also part of the filename

dir_key.description: Zero-padded id + slug, matches LeetHub folder naming

started_at.description: UTC; also encoded into the session filename

ended_at.description: When the session was finished, given up, or abandoned

outcome.description: accepted = solved; gave_up = explicit give-up; abandoned = session left open and flushed later

phases.description: Ordered, non-overlapping segments; gaps allowed (page reloads etc.)

phase_totals_sec.description: Active seconds per phase (pauses excluded); user-editable on the save form, so may not equal the sum of the phases array

run_count.description: Times the user ran the code against the examples

failed_run_count.description: Runs whose result was not accepted

logic_idea.description: The user's approach in their own words; seeded from the thinking-area block in the editor, editable on the save form

comments.description: Free-form notes entered on the save form

client.description: Which client wrote this record; intentionally open for forward compatibility
